create_VideoGroundingDataset: create a VideoGroundingDataset instance for video grounding with configurable frame sampling and query limits
sample_stage_ids_frames: sample a subset of stage ids from video queries with configurable stride for training frame subsampling
filter_query_and_annotations: filter video queries and annotations to keep only selected stages and optionally remap stage ids
tile_single_image_video: tile a single image and its queries into multiple stages to simulate video frames for training
subsample_find_queries: subsample find queries per frame to keep at most max_query_num queries and avoid OOM errors
